description: PN Octave Probability expands Probably Not(e) and goes immediately to its right; it moves the notes selected here by whole octaves, picking the octave at random from the eleven weights set here.

params.text: Turns octave shifting on or off for that note; only the notes switched on here are moved.
Sets the weight of that octave shift, 0 to 100%; the chance of its being used is that weight as a share of the total of the eleven octave knobs.
An attenuverter, -100% to +100%, scaling the voltage at the input it belongs with before that voltage is added to the octave weight.

inputs.text: A trigger here turns octave shifting for that note on or off.
Voltage here is added to the weight of that octave through its attenuverter, 0-10V covering the full range of the weight.

notes: several of these can be chained one after another so that different notes take different octave probabilities.
